description:
A library of extensions that has proved to be useful during some years.
		  Instead of repeating this functionality everywhere, it is now collected
		  in one place: strings, nullable numbers, colors, dates and times, LINQ,
		  pagination, markdown, results of operations and HTTP requests, IDataRecord, and corrections of typed input such as
		  name capitalization for European countries, ordinary text, email and MAC
		  addresses and number ranges.
releaseNotes:
Version 3.0.0
		  Breaking changes:
		  - ToDouble on DateTime and TimeSpan gives the time of day as a fraction of a day (12:00 is 0.5); GetTimeAsDouble follows.
		  - OrException() throws InvalidOperationException instead of NullReferenceException.
		  - GetColumnIndexes returns IReadOnlyDictionary; Columns is sealed; Pages() takes maxHeight as a double.
		  - GetString on data records gives the default value, when one is given, for a null value.
		  Fixes:
		  - Span() and Div() wrap any text, close the div and HTML-encode text and class.
		  - IndexOfContains no longer overflows the stack; HHMM is HH:mm in every culture.
		  - TryGetFirstValue tells a match from no match for value types; Pages() adds no empty page.
		  - Data record getters use the default value for a missing column; pagination checks items per page.
		  - Generic extensions are classic extension methods, so they load under Blazor WebAssembly.
		  New:
		  - ToResultAsync<T>(JsonTypeInfo<T>): source-generated JSON, safe under trimming and Native AOT.
		  - TextCleanup.PlainCharacters. The package is AOT-compatible and documents every public member.
		  See RELEASENOTES.md in the repository for details.

		  Version 2.4.0
		  - Requires .NET 11.
		  - Result<T>: a C# 15 union of SuccessWithData<T>, SuccessNoData, FailureWithException, FailureWithStatusCode and
		  TimedOut, with IsSuccess, IsFailure, TryGetData, DataOrDefault and GetMessage(); AsResult<T>() on exceptions.
		  - ToResultAsync<T>() on HttpResponseMessage and Task<HttpResponseMessage>: the JSON body, the status code, a failed
		  request or the HttpClient timeout as a Result<T>.
		  - Markdig 1.6.0.

		  Version 2.3.0
		  - IsEmailAddress (one address, the HTML standard's rule) and IsEmailAddresses (addresses separated by semicolons, as
		  AsEmailAddresses gives them).
		  - Strings: Truncated(maxLength, ellipsis), WordWrapped(width, lineBreak), ToGuidOrNull and ToGuidOrNew().
		  - Text for display: WithInitialCapital and WithInitialLowerCase.
		  - Dates: ToDateText() and ToDateAndTimeText() on DateTimeOffset and DateTimeOffset?, ToPeriodText() on periods of
		  dates, ints and shorts.

		  Version 2.2.0
		  - Corrected(TextCase, TextCleanup = OrdinaryText): one declarative correction per field, the cleanup first, then the
		  casing; IsCorrected tells whether it would change nothing.
		  - TextCase (one per field): AsTyped, Capitalized ("CST" becomes "Cst"), Sentence (as Capitalized, but abbreviations
		  are kept: "STYCKEGODS" becomes "Styckegods", "Gas (LPG)" and "LPG" stay), InitialCapital (only the first letter),
		  UpperCase, LowerCase, Place, GivenName, FamilyName and Organisation.
		  - TextCleanup (flags that combine): Trimmed, OrdinaryText, NoSpaces, NoHyphens, NullIfEmpty.
		  - TextCasings: the TextCase per kind of text, for declaring the rules of a language or country in one place.
		  - The first letter is capitalised also after a leading quotation mark or digit.
		  - Obsolete: AsCapitalizedName and IsCapitalizedName with NameStyle; use Corrected (FirstLetter is InitialCapital,
		  AllWords is Place).

		  Version 2.1.0
		  - NamedColor(Name, HexColor), with TextColor, and ToNamedColors() on color names: name and hex code in the given
		  order, for example to build a color drop-down or swatches; an unknown name throws ArgumentException.

		  Version 2.0.0
		  Breaking changes:
		  - AsEnumerable() on any class is renamed ToSingleItemEnumerable(). It won over LINQ's AsEnumerable() for every
		  list, collection and query, so list.AsEnumerable() became a sequence holding the list.
		  - IsAnyOf(string?) and IsAnyPartOf(string?) with comma-separated values are renamed IsAnyOfCommaSeparated and
		  IsAnyPartOfCommaSeparated: a single string argument silently picked them.
		  - FirstItem trims the item and skips empty items; HexColor returns capitals and accepts #RGB and hex without #.
		  New:
		  - Nullable numbers: IsNullOrZero, IsNullOrZeroOrNegative, OrNullIfZero, OrNullIfZeroOrNegative.
		  - Strings: OrNullIfEmpty, FirstItem with a separator, HasValueExcept(params string[]) case-insensitive,
		  WithoutQuotationMarks keeping apostrophes.
		  - Colors: NormalizedHexColor, IsKnownColor, TryGetHexColor, ContrastingTextColor(threshold).
		  - Tellurian.Utilities.Text: name capitalization for 17 European countries (AsCapitalizedName, NameStyle),
		  AsOrdinaryText, AsEmailAddresses, AsMacAddress and IsMacAddress, number ranges (AsNumberRanges,
		  TryParseNumberRanges, ToCollapsedRanges).
		  - README: these extensions must not be used inside EF Core queries.
title: Tellurian.Utilities
